module: 'Relative' odometer for statistics: integrates the distance traveled from electrics.values.wheelspeed with a 'rope' filter (±5 cm) to ignore back-and-forth oscillations, then submits the distance to gameplayStatistic (metrics 'vehicle/odometer/<model>.length' and 'vehicle/total_odometer.length'). Only counts when the AI is disabled.
usage: local d = extensions.odometer.getRelativeRecording()  -- cumulative distance in m
notes: Algorithm: lead accumulates |wheelspeed| * dt * sign(avgWheelAV); as soon as |lead| exceeds ropeLength (0.05 m) the excess is added to relativeOdometer and lead is clamped.

submitStatistic sends nothing if ai.mode ~= 'disabled' or if less than 1 m has been accumulated since the last send. If the average speed since the send exceeds 150 m/s (550 km/h) the distance is discarded as inconsistent. A NaN relativeOdometer is reset to the previous value with an error log.
Automatic send every 30 s of accumulated time (when the AI is disabled) and on each reset. The model name is extracted from v.vehicleDirectory (pattern /vehicles/<model>).

Anomaly: submitedTime is only reset to 0 after a periodic send; the average speed tested (distance / submitedTime) is therefore computed over time accumulated since the last periodic send, not since the last submitStatistic.
startRecording is empty (the reset is commented out); onExtensionLoaded is empty.

onReset.desc: Vehicle reset hook: submits the accumulated distance to the statistics.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: integrates the distance and triggers the periodic send.

startRecording.desc: Intended to reset the recording; does nothing (commented-out code).

submitStatistic.desc: Sends the distance not yet submitted to gameplayStatistic (conditions described in the notes).
